display.purpose: Start title and Victory / Defeat; Marcellus SC, words only.

headline.purpose: Fighter names, run title, rules drawer title.

title.purpose: Panel and section headings, the incoming question (2.25rem), phase tabs, item names.

inscription-word.purpose: Block / Dodge answer names and the fx outcome words.

numeral.purpose: HP in the windows; every numeral is Atkinson 700 tabular, never Marcellus (its 0 and 1 read as O and I).

numeral-small.purpose: Record, costs, point values, build stats, answer odds (1.05 to 1.5rem).

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked meter labels, roundel slots, delta labels, table headers.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: No elevation shadows: depth is tonal stone over nave, edges are 1px lead seams, peer cells sit in 3px leaded grids.

shadows.name: fx-ring
shadows.purpose: Outcome light only: clear for block, violet for stun, and the outcome's tincture in reduced-motion held states.

motion.name: t-med
motion.purpose: Pane lighting, meter width, rise-in of exchanges, toasts, drawer, incoming pane arrival.

motion.name: t-fx
motion.purpose: fx-hit crack, fx-block flash, fx-dodge word, fx-counter flash.

motion.name: fx-heal
motion.purpose: Verdant rise from the window foot.

motion.name: window-shudder
motion.purpose: Struck window on hit, counter and KO.

motion.name: fx-ko
motion.purpose: Fallen window; HP panes hatched in lead.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation off; each fx holds a 3px tincture ring, a 0.08 to 0.12 tint wash and its word fixed at the window foot; global durations collapse to 1ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that advances the loop; amber because it is the decision now.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">Begin round 3 <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>

components.css: .ds-window { width: 300px; display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 24px 24px; background: #17191d; border: 1px solid #2c2f35; border-top: 4px solid #3d74d8; border-radius: 0 0 3px 3px; color: #e6e3dc; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-wname { margin: 0; font: 400 1.6rem/1.1 'Marcellus SC', serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-wrow { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-wlabel { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #b2aea6; } .ds-wnum { color: #8b8780; } .ds-wnum b { font: 700 2rem/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; color: #e6e3dc; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-panes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(10, 1fr); gap: 3px; padding: 3px; background: #2c2f35; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-panes i { height: 16px; background: #22252b; transition: background 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-panes i.on { background: #3d74d8; } .ds-stun i { height: 10px; } .ds-stun i.on { background: #8a64d6; }

components.css: .ds-incoming { display: grid; gap: 8px; justify-items: center; text-align: center; padding: 24px 24px 16px; background: #17191d; border: 1px solid #2c2f35; border-radius: 3px; outline: 2px solid #dfa634; outline-offset: -2px; color: #e6e3dc; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-incoming h3 { margin: 0; font: 400 2.25rem/1.1 'Marcellus SC', serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-answers { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; width: 100%; margin-top: 12px; } .ds-answer { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; text-align: left; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid #3a3e46; background: #1f2227; color: #e6e3dc; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 140ms, transform 140ms; } .ds-answer:hover { border-color: #dfa634; background: #272a30; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-answer:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dfa634; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ahead { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; } .ds-ahead b { font: 400 1.6rem 'Marcellus SC', serif; } .ds-ahead em { margin-left: auto; font: 700 1.5rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; font-style: normal; color: #f0c56a; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-answer small { color: #b2aea6; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.css: .ds-roundels { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 16px; display: grid; gap: 8px; background: #17191d; color: #e6e3dc; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-roundel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr; gap: 12px; align-items: center; } .ds-glass { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid #2c2f35; background: #22252b; color: #8b8780; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-roundel.is-filled .ds-glass { --lit: #2f60bd; --lit-2: #3d74d8; color: #f3f4f6; background: conic-gradient(from 22.5deg, var(--lit) 0 45deg, var(--lit-2) 45deg 90deg, var(--lit) 90deg 135deg, var(--lit-2) 135deg 180deg, var(--lit) 180deg 225deg, var(--lit-2) 225deg 270deg, var(--lit) 270deg 315deg, var(--lit-2) 315deg 360deg); } .ds-roundel.boss .ds-glass { --lit: #b3313a; --lit-2: #cf3b41; } .ds-roundel.is-filled .ds-glass::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 11px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #2c2f35; background: #121418; } .ds-glass svg { position: relative; } .ds-rtext { display: grid; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-slot { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8b8780; } .ds-roundel:not(.is-filled) b { color: #8b8780; font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Outcome Light
components.description: Signature: each exchange as light in the struck window; hover to replay. Reduced motion holds a tincture ring and the word.
components.css: .ds-fxrow { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; background: #0e0f12; } .ds-fxwin { position: relative; overflow: hidden; width: 160px; height: 110px; background: #17191d; border: 1px solid #2c2f35; border-top: 4px solid #3d74d8; } .ds-fx { position: absolute; inset: 0; } .ds-fx::after { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 12px; transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 4px 14px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgb(14 15 18 / 0.86); font: 400 1rem 'Marcellus SC', serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-fx-block { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #c9d3d8; background: rgb(201 211 216 / 0.22); } .ds-fx-block::after { content: 'Blocked'; color: #c9d3d8; } .ds-fx-stun { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #8a64d6; background: rgb(138 100 214 / 0.34); } .ds-fx-stun::after { content: 'Stunned'; color: #b9a0f0; } .ds-fx-counter { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #dfa634; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, rgb(223 166 52 / 0.38), transparent 62%); } .ds-fx-counter::after { content: 'Countered'; color: #f0c56a; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-fxwin:hover .ds-fx { animation: ds-flash 620ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } } @keyframes ds-flash { from { opacity: 0; } 25% { opacity: 1; } }

components.css: .ds-hand { margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 3px; background: #121418; border: 1px solid #2c2f35; color: #e6e3dc; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-fan { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 3px; padding: 3px; background: #2c2f35; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-fc { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-height: 150px; padding: 12px; background: #22252b; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-fc.is-equal { background: #26222c; } .ds-fc.is-played { background: #2a1a1c; outline: 2px solid #cf3b41; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-fc.is-weaker { background: #0e0f12; } .ds-fi { font: 700 1.4rem/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; color: #f0868a; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-fc.is-weaker .ds-fi { color: #b2aea6; } .ds-fi small { font-size: 0.8rem; } .ds-fa { font: 400 0.95rem 'Marcellus SC', serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-fm { margin-top: auto; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; color: #8b8780; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-hand figcaption { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #b2aea6; } .ds-hand figcaption b { color: #e6e3dc; }

narrative.overview:
A dark nave where colour exists only as lit glass, and glass lights only when something happens. The ground is night-nave black, every working surface is a slab of dark stone, and stone slabs and glass cells are separated by dark lead seams, never by shadows. Colour is not decoration: six jewel tinctures each mean exactly one thing, and they appear only where a pane is lit by game state (your health, the boss's health, the decision in front of you, a stun, a heal, a block).

The fight is two lancet windows facing each other across an aisle, the player's lit in azure and the boss's in gules, with the one decision you must answer between them as the single amber-ringed pane. Health and stun are rows of leaded panes rather than bars; gear is shown as segmented glass roundels lit in the owner's tincture; the boss's ranked plans are a fan of leaded cells. Every exchange plays out as light in the struck window, one short, purposeful animation per outcome, and each has a held, motionless equivalent under reduced motion.

Names and short word inscriptions are cut in Marcellus SC; everything read, and every numeral, is set in Atkinson Hyperlegible. The world refuses the gold-filigree RPG panel and the grey analytics dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Nave ground, stone surfaces, lead seams: depth by tone and seam, never by shadow.
Six tinctures, one meaning each: azure you, gules boss, amber your decision now, violet stun, verdant healing, clear glass blocked or dodged.
Leaded pane meters for HP and stun; leaded cell grids for armory, stats, rewards and the boss's plans.
Gear as flat, eight-segment glass roundels lit in the owner's tincture.
Marcellus SC for word inscriptions only; Atkinson Hyperlegible for UI and all numerals.
One outcome animation per exchange (hit, block, dodge, counter, stun, heal, skip, strike, KO), each with a reduced-motion held state.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each tincture means one thing everywhere: azure you, gules boss, amber the decision now (and counters), violet stun, verdant healing, clear blocked or dodged. Never use a tincture as decoration or for a second meaning.

rules.name: The Lit Glass Rule
rules.body: Saturated colour appears only where game state lights a pane. The shell (top bar, ground, panel fills, nav) stays nave, stone and lead.

rules.name: The Text Tint Rule
rules.body: Tincture text on stone uses the -text step (azure-text, gules-text, amber-text, violet-text, verdant-text); the base glass steps are for fills, rings and panes.

rules.name: The Legible Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every numeral is Atkinson Hyperlegible 700 with tabular figures, including numerals inside Marcellus headings (wrap them in the numeral style). Marcellus SC's 0 and 1 read as O and I.

rules.name: The Inscription Rule
rules.body: Marcellus SC carries names and short words only; sentences are never set in it.

rules.name: The Lead Seam Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with a 1px lead seam or a 3px leaded gap, never a shadow. A thing is raised only by being lighter stone.

rules.name: The Leaded Grid Rule
rules.body: Any set of peer cells (armory, build stats, rewards, status, the boss's plans, HP and stun panes) is a leaded grid: lead ground, 3px padding, 3px gaps, 1px cell corners.

dos: Do keep each tincture to its one meaning: azure you, gules boss, amber the decision now, the primary action, selection, focus and counters, violet stun, verdant healing, clear blocked or dodged.
Do separate surfaces with 1px lead seams and group peer cells in leaded grids (3px lead padding and gaps, 1px cell corners).
Do set every numeral in Atkinson Hyperlegible 700 with tabular figures, including inside Marcellus headings.
Do show meters as rows of leaded panes and gear as segmented glass roundels lit in the owner's tincture.
Do give every outcome animation a held reduced-motion state with a tincture ring and its word.
Do declare flexible grid tracks as minmax(0, 1fr) and collapse at 1080px and 760px.
donts: Don't use drop shadows for depth; the only inset rings are outcome light.
Don't set numerals or sentences in Marcellus SC.
Don't light a tincture for decoration, or give amber to anything other than the decision now, primary action, selection, focus or counters.
Don't round surfaces past 3px or use pills for anything but chips.
Don't use Unicode glyphs for icons; icons are the authored 24-grid SVG set.
Don't drift toward the gold-filigree RPG panel or the grey dashboard.
